_doc: A lift is a condition under which a trigger phrase may appear. Each lift has alternatives; one alternative must hold. Keys: evidence_types, scope, comparison, channels, domains (answers) and kinds (template kind). Used by library check 3, the engine validator and the 'Don't say' filter.

cert.label: Only with a certificate from a scheme that meets the legal criteria for certification schemes

label.label: Only for a certified label or an official, mandatory label

ecolabel.label: Only with a valid EU Ecolabel licence for this product

emas.label: Only with a valid EMAS registration, for the organisation or site, never on products or packaging

organic.label: Only for certified organic production under Regulation (EU) 2018/848

measured.label: Only with the figure stated and evidence held

tested.label: Only with a test report or certificate for the stated conditions

scoped.label: Only when the part, site or share covered is stated

compared.label: Only with a named comparator, the same method and evidence

company.label: Only as a company-level statement, never about a product

plan.label: Only with a public implementation plan, interim targets and independent verification

product_type.label: Only to name the authorised product type in neutral or mandatory wording
